needs_human.note: A reindex request that mixes `ocr` with valid tasks is refused as a whole with 422, not split per task.; isPicture in core searchCapture.ts matches any `image/*` mime, not just the OCR set. Only text_content rows produce content_matches, so in practice it affects only pictures with OCR rows.; IndexDetailsDialog keeps its own copy of the OCR mime set (OCR_MIME_TYPES), so it can drift from the backend's OCR_IMAGE_TYPES.

IndexDetailsResponse.image_ocr is a new API field that the touch points do not name.; reindex_file returns 422 for an ocr task on a non-picture file, which no invariant names (I4 names only mode false).
